names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 iulie, «Sfânta Muceniță Teodota cu fiii săi», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Ιουλίου, «Αγία Θεοδότη και τα τρία παιδιά της», with the rank word and the children's clause left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s second heading for 22. децембар ст. ст., „Света мученица Теодотија с три детета.“ — «Света» is “saint” and not a rank, «мученица» is the rank `martyr` the folder already carries, and «с три детета», with three children, is the count the display name already carries and not a by-name, so the bare forename is what is left. The book gives her no by-name of any kind. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN, AND IT LANDS ON ANOTHER FOLDER: `theodote-of-nicaea` already carries the identical Serbian string, so the fold key «теодотија» is declared in the same commit with both holders read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 iulie — «Sfânta Muceniță Teodota cu fiii săi»

attestations.note: Not the Theodote this corpus keeps on 17 septembrie, who was of the Euxine Pontus and was beheaded under Alexander Severus; doxologia's woman here is of Cilicia and was burned in a furnace with her three children.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Ιουλίου — «Αγία Θεοδότη και τα τρία παιδιά της»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the woman is the folder's own: the ruler Λευκάδιος who had asked her in marriage and was refused, and Νικήτιος the ruler of Bithynia who threw her and her three children into a white-hot furnace, are the Leucadius and Nicetius of the Romanian life. The two accounts differ on where she came from: doxologia says Cilicia, saint.gr «Η Αγία Θεοδότη καταγόταν από τη Νίκαια της Βιθυνίας», from Nicaea in Bithynia. The difference is recorded and neither page is corrected by the other. saint.gr adds that her memory with her three children is repeated on 22 Δεκεμβρίου «με παρόμοια βιογραφικά στοιχεία», with similar biographical data; one row per church is the schema, so that second Greek day is recorded here and is not a second row or a second folder. The page names none of the three children and gives no year, so they still have no folders and no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. It prints one apolytikion, which names her, and it is taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.01.2026 (22. децембар ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Теодотија с три детета.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE FOLDER’S OWN LIFE AND NOT A GUESS FROM THE NAME: that life already records, out of saint.gr, that the memory of this Theodota and her three children is kept again on 22 December with similar biographical details, which is exactly this day; and the entry matches the dossier point for point — the young widow with three children brought up in the faith, the trial at which she confessed boldly, the sending to Никитије the proconsul of Bithynia, and the burning furnace into which she was thrown with all three. The folder’s other churches keep her on 29 July, and its `serbian` row was `undocumented`, so nothing of this church’s was moved or replaced and no second-day note is owed — the shape is the 12-21 reader’s `peter-of-moscow` case. THE PLACE DIFFERS ACROSS THE THREE BOOKS AND WAS NOT RESOLVED: the Prologue puts her where Anastasia was, in Macedonia, the Romanian makes her of Cilicia and saint.gr of Nicaea in Bithynia; all three are recorded in the life and the folder claims none of them in a `locations` key, which it has never had. NO YEAR ANYWHERE: the entry gives none, so the folder’s empty `dates` is left empty. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that she was left a young widow and gave herself wholly to the service of God and the rearing of her children; that Анастасија lodged with her and the two went round the prisons together, which is this day’s first entry and takes a `related` row both ways in this same commit; and that when a shameless heathen made to touch her body he saw an angel of God beside her of a sudden and was struck by the angel. The three children are counted and unnamed here as in the other two books, so they take no folders. The Serbian form is the heading’s bare forename and it lands on `theodote-of-nicaea`, which already holds the identical string, so the two-member fold key «теодотија» is declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this same commit with both holders read. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Mieluşeaua Ta, Iisuse, Teodota, strigă cu glas mare: pe Tine, Mirele meu, te iubesc și pe Tine căutându-Te mă chinuiesc și împreună mă răstignesc și împreună mă îngrop cu Botezul Tău; și pătimesc pentru Tine, ca să împărățesc întru Tine; și mor pentru tine, ca să viez pentru Tine; ci, ca o jertfă fără de prihană, primește-mă pe mine ceea ce cu dragoste mă jertfesc Ție. Pentru rugăciunile ei, ca un milostiv, mântuiește sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfintei Mucenițe Teodota», Glasul 4 — the common of one woman martyr, as the page prints it for her

english.text: Your lamb, Jesus, Theodota, cries out with a great voice: You, my Bridegroom, I love, and seeking You I am tormented, and I am crucified with You and buried with You in Your baptism; and I suffer for You, that I may reign in You; and I die for You, that I may live for You. But receive me, as a spotless sacrifice, offering myself to You in love. By her prayers, as You are merciful, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς δῶρον ἐκλεκτόν, Θεοδότη θεόφρον, προσήγαγες Θεῷ, τοὺς ἐνθέους βλαστούς σου, σὺν τούτοις γὰρ ἠγώνισαι, ἱερῶς ἐναθλήσασα, μεθ’ ὧν πρέσβευε, ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ, δοῦναι ἄφεσιν, ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῖν πᾶσι, καὶ βίου διόρθωσιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τὸν τάφον σου Σωτὴρ — the only hymn on the page of «Αγία Θεοδότη», and it names her and her offspring

english.text: As a chosen gift you brought to God your godly offshoots, Theodota of godly mind; for with them you struggled and contended in holiness. With them intercede to the Lord for us, that he grant to us all the forgiveness of sins and the setting right of our life.
